Install: ci-doctor matchers add official/ruby_exception

matchers/ruby/ruby_exception/matcher.yaml

id: ruby_exception
role: tool
classification: [ruby, runtime]
description: An unhandled Ruby exception - a backtrace frame naming the error class.
pattern: \.rb:\d+:in .+\(\w*(Error|Exception)\)
before: 2
after: 10

In bundles

allruby
